type Word = NoInfer<string>;
const word: Word = "ok";
function choose<T>(source: T, fallback: NoInfer<T>): T { return source; }
console.log(choose(word, "fallback"));
function alone<T>(value: NoInfer<T>): T {return value;}
const unknownValue: unknown = alone(1);
console.log(unknownValue);
function both<T>(x: NoInfer<T> & T): T {return x;}
const numberValue: number = both(1);
console.log(numberValue);
function either<T>(x: NoInfer<T> | T): T {return x;}
const textValue: string = either("x");
console.log(textValue);
function street<C extends string>(colors: C[], defaultColor?: NoInfer<C>) {return defaultColor ?? colors[0];}
console.log(street(["red", "green"], "red"));
const iterator = [1].values();
const first = iterator.next();
if (!first.done) console.log(first.value.toFixed());
console.log(iterator.next().value);
const mapEntry = new Map([["a", 2]]).entries().next();
if (!mapEntry.done) console.log(mapEntry.value[0], mapEntry.value[1]);
